blurb: Looking for a fun activity for your party, group or event? Our complete 8 lane bowling alley is available for your group. Rental of our complete facility is available for only $ 150.00 per hour. That includes exclusive use of our bowling alley. Balls and shoes are included. An internet powered juke box is available for music. Catered snacks and beverages are available with advance notice for an additional charge.
